create_project_description: Set the project and customer name so you can start planning right away.
duplicate_project_description: Create a copy and adjust the project or customer name before you continue.
edit_project_description: Update the project and customer name without creating a new entry.
delete_project_message: Do you want to move the project '{name}' to the trash?
empty_projects: No projects available. Click on 'New Project'.
empty_projects_instruction: Tap the menu button in the bottom left and choose "{action}".

empty_projects_sign_in_instruction: Open "{action}" and sign in before creating your first project.
empty_projects_sign_in_detail: After that, you can create projects and link your data to your account.
backup_card_description: Export all active projects to one XML backup or import a saved backup file.
backup_import_dialog_description: Choose a saved TilePro XML file to restore projects from a backup.

backup_no_projects: No active projects are available for export.
backup_export_share_opened: The backup export was opened. Choose where to save or share the XML file.
backup_invalid_file: The selected file is not a valid TilePro backup.
backup_operation_failed: The backup operation could not be completed.
project_export_mail_description: Review the mail and send the XML export for project '{name}'.
project_export_mail_body:
Hello,

attached is the XML export for project '{name}'.

Best regards
project_export_failed: The project export mail could not be prepared.
debug_delete_local_projects_description: Developer tool: This permanently removes all projects and related data from the local database. All locally stored data will be lost.
debug_delete_local_projects_success: All local project data has been deleted.
debug_delete_local_projects_failed: Local project data could not be deleted.
